name: gif-meme
description: Turn a short video into a looping GIF that fits a byte budget, then publish it where GIF search actually looks — Tenor (Gboard, WhatsApp, Discord, Google Messages) and GIPHY (Slack, Instagram, iMessage) — driven over the Chrome DevTools Protocol with the measured per-site footguns pre-empted: hidden file inputs, a tag box that drops every other tag, a 48-hour review queue, and a search-placement gate that needs five uploads before you can even apply.
